programs.title: Life Below Zero: Port Protection Alaska 6
programs.sub_title: Meeting at the end of the world
programs.desc: Residents of Port Protection fish, hunt and collect firewood.They have no roads, police or offices, but are threatened by wolves and bears.However, no one is thinking about returning to the city.

programs.title: The Spying Game: Tales from the Cold War
programs.desc: The creators of the program talk about operations undertaken during the Cold War by intelligence officers of the United States of America, the Soviet Union and other countries.

programs.title: Goulag: Une histoire soviétique
programs.desc: Millions of people were sent to forced labor camps in the USSR, including many Poles.Often their fate remained unknown.Not only criminals were sent there, but also political opponents and citizens who offended the system.Cheap labor in mines, quarries and logging was to support the economy.All documents have not yet been declassified.Knowledge about labor camps can be derived, among others, from literature - "The Gulag Archipelago" by Alexander Solzhenitsyn or "Another World" by Gustaw Herling-Grudziński.

programs.title: Border Patrol
programs.desc: Employees of the Customs Service and the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry form a patrol guarding New Zealand's borders.The threat to the country is the smuggling of drugs, weapons and other illegal materials.

programs.title: To Catch a Smuggler: Tropical Takedown
programs.desc: Behind the scenes of the fight against the international cocaine trade in the Caribbean.AMO agents and DHS investigators conduct intensive operations in Puerto Rico and neighboring islands, thwarting smuggling attempts.

programs.desc: National Geographic inspires the explorer in everyone through breathtaking documentaries on science, history, and the natural wonders of our planet.

programs.title: Staline en couleur
programs.desc: Documentarians colorized archival materials depicting Stalin.The Soviet dictator is considered one of the greatest criminals of the 20th century.It is estimated that his rule claimed the lives of several dozen million people.The despot, overcome with persecution mania, issued death sentences to everyone he suspected of alleged conspiracy activities.No one in his immediate circle could feel safe, including party dignitaries, friends and family members.

programs.title: Nazi Megastructures 6
programs.desc: Details of military solutions, tactics and technologies used by countries participating in World War II will be presented.The creators will reveal what the German anti-aircraft defense system looked like and will also talk about the Burma Death Railway.The 415 km long line was built by Japan.Its creation resulted in the death of thousands of people, mainly prisoners of war and civilians.Historians will also go on a journey around the Pacific islands, visiting places in Europe and Africa where fierce fighting took place.In the bunkers built on the territory of the Third Reich, you can still find remains of equipment and impressive fortifications.The enormous structures were intended to ensure that Hitler maintained control over the Old Continent.

programs.title: Monaco Grand Prix: Backstages of a Mythical Race
programs.desc: The legendary Formula 1 race in Monte Carlo is broadcast in 90 countries.In seven weeks, teams build a 3.5-kilometer track and stands for 20,000 spectators.It's a race against time, with no room for mistakes.
